<function name="Normalize" parent="Angle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Normalizes the angles by applying a modulo with 360 to pitch, yaw and roll.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Example usage of the function.</description>
	<code>
local a = Angle( 0, 181, 1 )
a:Normalize()
print( a )
	</code>
	<output>0.000 -179.000 1.000</output>

</example>
